"Hi Swayamjeet, I am looking to develop a smart home automation IoT app to control custom ESP32/ESP8266 hardware devices (4-channel switches).
Key requirements:
Device provisioning (Wi-Fi pairing / BLE / SoftAP)
Real-time control via MQTT broker / Cloud backend
Offline local LAN control (mDNS / Local IP fallback)
Real-time switch status sync
Can you handle end-to-end IoT firmware integration and MQTT backend setup within your ₹29,999 package, or does this require a custom quote? Let me know.
